Thanks Lauren — good notes.

Confirmations:
- SOC 2 Type II: coverage through June 30, 2027 would be preferred (we usually ask auditors for the 12-month window ending closest to the contract date). If you have a report that covers Jul 2026–Jun 2027, that will work.
- Bridge letter: yes — if your most recent Type II ends before our review, a bridge/interim attestation stating controls are unchanged since the last report is acceptable.
- Upload recipient: security@novapulse.com (we'll create a read-only reviewer account called "Novapulse Reviewer" if that helps).
- Regs: we require confirmation on HIPAA (if you handle PHI) and GDPR data processing terms (we'll want the DPA). We can review addenda during contracting.

I've attached our vendor questionnaire (novapulse_vendor_questionnaire.xlsx) — if you can pre-fill the high-level answers and return where you can't provide artifacts, we'll mark them for review.

If you can get the bridge letter draft and portal invite by EOD tomorrow 08/04 that would keep us on a tight timeline for procurement.

Best,
Katherine Moss
